cards.title: Rating scale, notchChange and notchCalculator (REQ-06-02)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-06-02 needs a notch calculator. It takes the analyst's previous and current rating and returns the signed notch change, the direction and the resulting WL (0-4, higher is worse; only 0, 1 or 2 here). It uses the Indicator 13 thresholds (C2) but do NOT build a separate Indicator 13 function: no `externalRatingChangeWl` export. T-02 imports `notchChange` from this module, so names and signatures are a fixed contract.

CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node.js 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, no build step, no TypeScript, do not edit package.json. Pure functions, no I/O in src/ratings: no imports at all, no console.*. Tests: node:test + node:assert/strict in test/<area>/<name>.test.mjs. src/ and test/ hold only .gitkeep.

FILES: create src/ratings/notch.mjs and test/ratings/notch.test.mjs.

CONTRACT (named exports):
1. `RATING_SCALE`: Object.freeze'd array of the 19 ratings, best first: ["AAA","AA+","AA","AA-","A+","A","A-","BBB+","BBB","BBB-","BB+","BB","BB-","B+","B","B-","CCC+","CCC","CCC-"] (ASCII hyphen-minus and plus).
2. `notchChange(previous, current)` -> integer index(current) - index(previous). Positive = downgrade, negative = upgrade, 0 = unchanged; must return +0, never -0 (Object.is(result, 0)).
3. `notchCalculator(previous, current)` -> NEW plain unfrozen object with exactly keys { notches, direction, wl }: notches = notchChange value (C5); direction = "downgrade" if >0, "upgrade" if <0, "unchanged" if 0; wl = 2 if notches >= 3, 1 if notches == 2, else 0 (C2, C3, C6).
Both functions take exactly two parameters (.length === 2), are synchronous and stateless.

INPUT NORMALISATION (shared helper, may stay unexported): first `typeof x === "string"` else RangeError (covers null, undefined, missing, 7, {}, ["BBB"], new String("BBB")); then x.trim() (binding human answer: removes all leading/trailing whitespace incl. NBSP U+00A0, U+2003, BOM U+FEFF); then .toUpperCase() (not toLocaleUpperCase); the result must exactly equal a RATING_SCALE entry else RangeError. Rejected: internal whitespace ("BBB +"), AAA+, CCC--, D, SD, NR, Baa1, U+2212 minus, full-width letters, empty/blank. Validate previous first, then current; message names the argument and bad value, but tests assert only instanceof RangeError.

TRAP: the POC example 'BBB+ -> BB+ = 2 notches -> WL 1' is wrong; C2 overrides: 3 notches, WL 2. Cite C2 in that test's name.

TESTING: TDD. The all-pairs test (AC-6) loops RATING_SCALE x RATING_SCALE (361 pairs).
acceptance: AC-1: RATING_SCALE deep-equals the 19 C1 ratings in order, length 19, frozen; push('D') throws TypeError.
AC-3 (notch part): case and surrounding whitespace (incl. NBSP, em space, BOM) accepted by notchChange and notchCalculator.
AC-4 (notch part): notchChange and notchCalculator throw RangeError for every invalid value of plan AC-4, as previous and as current.
AC-5: notchCalculator deep-equals the plan table (BBB+->BB+ is {3,downgrade,2}).
AC-6: all 361 pairs: notches, direction and wl follow the rules.
AC-9 (notch part): notchCalculator.length === 2 and no state between calls.
AC-11 (notch part): named exports only, no externalRatingChangeWl, no imports, no console.*, synchronous, package.json unchanged.
AC-12 (notch part): node:test + node:assert/strict; node --test exits 0.

cards.title: Indicator 12 country rating change WL (REQ-03-12)
cards.context:
WHY: REQ-03-12 (Indicator 12, country rating change) is auto-calculated from the previous and current country rating; the result is WL 0, 1 or 2. It must be built on notchChange from T-01, with no copy of the scale or notch logic.

CONVENTIONS (CLAUDE.md): plain Node.js 18+ ESM (.mjs), no npm dependencies, do not edit package.json. Pure functions, no I/O in src/indicators: no console.*, no node: modules, fs, http, process. Tests: node:test + node:assert/strict.

DEPENDS ON T-01, which provides src/ratings/notch.mjs: `RATING_SCALE` (frozen 19 ratings AAA..CCC-), `notchChange(previous, current)` (integer index(current)-index(previous), downgrade positive, +0 for unchanged, trims, upper-cases, throws RangeError if off-scale, previous checked first), `notchCalculator(previous, current)` -> {notches, direction, wl}. Do not modify notch.mjs; report defects instead.

FILES: create src/indicators/countryRating.mjs and test/indicators/countryRating.test.mjs.

CONTRACT: `export function countryRatingChangeWl(previous, current)` returns 0, 1 or 2: n = notchChange(previous, current); 2 if n >= 2, 1 if n === 1, else 0 (upgrades and unchanged -> 0, C3). Only import allowed: `import { notchChange } from "../ratings/notch.mjs"`. No rating list literal in this file. Validation comes entirely from notchChange: invalid input throws RangeError synchronously; do not catch, wrap or fall back. Exactly two parameters (.length === 2), synchronous, stateless. No override parameter, persistence or audit trail (C7); fetching from a public source is out of scope (C4).

INTENDED DIFFERENCE (C6): for a 1-notch downgrade (BBB+ -> BBB) Indicator 12 gives WL 1 while notchCalculator gives wl 0. Both correct; pin it in a test importing both.

TESTING: TDD. The all-pairs test imports RATING_SCALE and notchChange from ../../src/ratings/notch.mjs and loops the 361 pairs. Add a source-level test reading src/indicators/countryRating.mjs as text (fs allowed in TESTS only): it imports notchChange from "../ratings/notch.mjs", has no other import, no "BBB+" or "CCC-" literal, no console. / process., and no mention of externalRatingChangeWl.
acceptance: AC-4 (indicator part): RangeError for every invalid value of plan AC-4, as previous and as current, and for ('XYZ','QQQ').
AC-10: imports notchChange from ../ratings/notch.mjs, no copy of the rating list, results follow notchChange.
AC-11 (indicator part): named export countryRatingChangeWl, no externalRatingChangeWl, only import is ../ratings/notch.mjs, no console.*/process, synchronous.
AC-12: node --test exits 0 and runs both test files.
